hidden_states.description: deterministic synthetic BF16 hidden states sampled from N(0, 1)

router.routing: FP32 softmax over all 512 logits, top-10 selection, then renormalization of selected route weights to sum to one

reference: FP32 weighted sum of top-10 outputs from original BF16 routed experts; each expert rounds the gated intermediate activation to BF16 before down_proj

dynamic_precision.decider: PagedMoE marginal-gain load/giveup algorithm mirrored from src/pagedmoe-core/src/precision.rs
dynamic_precision.cache_note: retained mode starts from zero precision and preserves loaded per-expert precision across these samples without modeling cache eviction
